retail.dispatch: game import byte table 0x44cc50, jump table 0x44c8d8

584.returns: the core's: 1 at the first model whose +0x30 is not -1, else 0

592.arguments: ghoul2, modelIndex, boneName, startFrame, endFrame, flags, animSpeed (float), currentTime, setFrame (float), blendTime

593.then: unbounded strcpy of the answer into the buffer

cores.592: end outside 1..99999 -> 1, start outside 0..99999 -> 0; set frame kept if -1, 0..100000 or NaN, else 0 (0x4a7462..0x4a74a8); null instance or modelIndex >= count (unsigned) -> 0; model +0x98 = 0 (0x4a74f6); 0x4ab390 finds (0x4aa8d0) or adds (0x4aa940) the bone by name and calls the setter 0x4ab070
cores.593: null instance or modelIndex >= count -> null; else the mdxm header's animName (+0x48) of the model's file (0x485220, 0x484bf0)
cores.596: field non-null -> nothing (0x4a7cfd); else a new 16-byte vector stored in the field, the field's address pushed on the server (0x1ae664c) or client (0x1ae6638) list by 0x5084a0 (0x4a7d2e..0x4a7d56), then 0x4a79e0(from, new, -1): every source model, removed ones included, assigned whole by 0x4a7b10
cores.599: field null -> nothing (0x4a6e06); else the field's address is found in 0x1ae664c, then 0x1ae6638, erased from the first that holds it and *field deleted (0x4a6d90); the field is emptied either way (0x4a6e80)
cores.588: allocates and lists the field before loading (0x4a6ef9..0x4a6f51); a failed load leaves the empty instance (0x4a6fe9)
cores.newBoneRecord: 0x4aaa0c: only the bone number and flags (0) are set; the rest is stack contents
cores.angleSetter: 0x4aaf85: replaces only the low three bits of the shared record's flags
cores.copyInstance: 0x4a79e0 returns -1; with -1 copies models 0..count-1, reusing destination places whose +0x30 is -1, else growing the destination

setter.function: 0x4ab070(boneList, index, startFrame, endFrame, flags, animSpeed, currentTime, setFrame, blendTime)
setter.blend: flags & 0x80 and the getter 0x4ab420 succeeds: blendStart == currentTime -> blendTime only (0x4ab0ee); speed < 0 -> blendFrame = blendLerpFrame = floor(frame) (0x4ab108..0x4ab157); else blendFrame = frame, blendLerpFrame = trunc(frame + 1), each >= the old end -> the old start (loop) or the old end - 1 (0 for an end <= 0) (0x4ab15c..0x4ab23f); blendTime; blendStart = currentTime
setter.noClip: getter fails: blendLerpFrame = blendFrame = blendTime = 0, 0x80 dropped (0x4ab262)
setter.start: setFrame == -1 -> currentTime; else trunc(currentTime - (setFrame - startFrame) * 50.0 / animSpeed) (0x4ab2fb..0x4ab32e; 50.0 double at 0x4e48a8)
setter.flags: (flags & ~0xd8) | the flags given, less 0x80 where dropped (0x4ab34a..0x4ab377)

getter.age: max(0, float((pauseTime ? pauseTime : now) - startTime) * 0.02f), stored as a float (0x4ab47c..0x4ab4fd)
getter.frame: float(startFrame + age * speed); a clip of no length answers its start
getter.loop: forwards keep frame < end, backwards frame > end + 1, else fmod(frame - end, size) + end - size
getter.otherwise: end - 1 forwards, end + 1 backwards, frozen or not

transform.inheritance: each child call restores this bone's newFrame, currentFrame, backlerp, blend frame, blend old frame, blend mode and blend lerp (0x476e2c..0x476eb7); the root starts at the model's default frame +0x94 (0 from 0x4a85a9 and 0x4a709a), fraction 0, no blend (0x477010)
transform.blend: flags & 0x80: age = float(now - blendStart); 0 <= age < blendTime -> blend mode with blendFrame, blendLerpFrame and lerp age / blendTime (0x4763f7..0x476465); else none; flags & 0x18 without 0x80 -> none; neither -> the parent's
transform.blendPose: (1 - f) * M(blendLerpFrame) + f * M(trunc(blendFrame)), f = blendFrame - trunc(blendFrame) (0x476959..0x4769d3)
transform.zeroSize: end - 1 (speed >= 0) or end + 1, not below 0, fraction 0 (0x4768d3..0x47690f)
transform.forward: current = trunc(frame), next = current + 1, fraction frame - current; next >= end -> start (loop) or end (0x4767d0..0x47682b)
transform.backward: speed <= 0: c = ceil(frame), fraction c - frame, current = c; c > start -> current = next = start, fraction 0; else next = c - 1, and !(end + 1 <= next) -> start (loop) or end + 1 (0x476830..0x4768d1)
transform.pastEndLoopForward: end - 1 < frame < end: current = trunc(frame), next = start; else w = fmod(frame - end, size) + end - size, current = trunc(w), next = w < end - 1 ? current + 1 : start (0x4766a7..0x47675d)
transform.pastEndLoopBackward: end <= frame < end + 1: fraction (end + 1) - frame, current = end, next = start; else the fmod wrap stored as a float, ceilings, next = wrapped > end + 1 ? current - 1 : start (0x4765c7..0x4766a2)
transform.pastEndFreeze: (flags & 0x48) == 0x48: current = next = end - 1 (speed > 0) or end + 1, fraction 0 (0x476762..0x4767ba)
transform.pastEndOther: nothing set: the bone keeps its parent's frames
transform.abandon: current < 0, next < 0, or in blend mode blendFrame < 0 or blendLerpFrame < 0: the bone and every bone below it are not transformed (0x476912..0x476951)
transform.zeroFraction: fraction 0 reads the current frame alone (0x4769f7)
